spot.html_text: It is not the case that actual infinity was universally rejected before Cantor. Set-theoretic views did not arise exclusively from analysis, but emerged also in algebra, number theory, and geometry. In fact, the rise of set-theoretic mathematics preceded Cantor’s crucial contributions.
